The assessment concerns a common restriction on ordinary outgoing transfers at source offset 1191 under management_role, transfer_condition. The scoped controller change prevents the same positive outgoing use for ordinary holders without an applicable exempt agent. A committing use and its control direction were checked on the actual ledger.
